name: Octree-GS
definition: A hierarchical LoD method that builds an octree over the scene, associating each node with a merged Gaussian that summarizes the radiance and opacity of its children.
summary: Octree-GS is a Level-of-Detail structured 3D Gaussian Splatting method that dynamically selects primitives from a sparse octree to solve inconsistent rendering and excessive memory usage in large-scale scenes.
